label: Classical-attributes field content: the nine versus the full Dei Filius list
resolution: The primitive field Signature.HasClassicalAttributes is undefined; this records the fork in its intended content, not a definition. CLASSICAL_FIELD_1 (the nine, NineClassicalAttributes) is what Root.lean documents. CLASSICAL_FIELD_2 (the full Dei Filius list in the typed reading of definition edcfac86, DeiFiliusAttributes) is what Dei Filius ch. 1, cited by ClassicalAttributesSuffice's docstring, DEF-CLASSICAL-ATTRIBUTES-BUNDLE and claim VATICAN-I-DEI-FILIUS-CH1-ONE-TRUE-LIVING-GOD, motivates. The Dei Filius batch states its field interpretation FieldFromDeiFilius on CLASSICAL_FIELD_2 only. Under CLASSICAL_FIELD_1 the old sufficiency premise is close to analytic and the seven bridges do no work for it; under CLASSICAL_FIELD_2 the warrant gap of the old premise is the field interpretation plus the bridges. Neither reading is selected; the formal results hold under both, since they never use the field's content.
